segments.text: Carl glass repair glass. >> What later became Carglass was founded back in 1932. Today we are a part of Belron and Belron and Carlos are the global leader in vehicle glass repair,

replacement and recalibration. We needed a system that could keep up with our ambitions in terms of scalability, data access and collaboration. So we started out upgrading our ERP onrem solution to the cloud.
Moving to the cloud seemed like an obvious choice for us in order to move forward and stay relevant. We have over a hundred of repair shops across Sweden or branches as we like to call them.

And before we move to Business Central, coordination of bookings was quite a struggle. Today, customers have suggested the next available time slot for the closest branch and a technician is automatically reserved when the booking is placed.

The information is then instantly available in the dimeuler overview and this is a huge improvement compared to the previous way of working. Choosing Microsoft felt like a natural step since we use Dynamics now for several years now and we also use Microsoft 365 suit across the organization.
So staying within Microsoft ecosystem just made sense for us. >> We at Cosmo have great experiences in bringing customers like Garlass to cloud. But it doesn't stop there.
Migrating data from onrem to cloud solution, it's only one part. Connecting data and making it smart, it's the actual game changer.

When moving to business center cloud, we saw immediate improvements. The booking site and the booking board runs much faster and we get access to data in real time. And what really stood out is the positive impact it had on customer satisfaction.
